title: 手机没电了 Shǒujī méi diàn le — A dead phone
summary: A dead battery and no address force a student to ask a stranger for help.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Xiǎo Zhōu dào chéng lǐ lái kàn biǎojiě.
body.en: Xiao Zhou comes to the city to see her cousin.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 火车上她一直在看手机。
body.py: huǒchē shàng tā yìzhí zài kàn shǒujī.
body.en: On the train she keeps looking at her phone.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 出站的时候，手机没电了。
body.py: chū zhàn de shíhou, shǒujī méi diàn le.
body.en: When she leaves the station, the phone is dead.

body.speaker: 小舟
body.zh: 地址在表里，我背不出来。
body.py: dìzhǐ zài biǎo lǐ, wǒ bèi bu chūlái.
body.en: The address is in the app and I cannot recite it.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 她在车站前面站了很久。
body.py: tā zài chēzhàn qiánmiàn zhàn le hěn jiǔ.
body.en: She stands in front of the station for a long time.

body.speaker: 小舟
body.py: wǒ méiyǒu qián, yě méiyǒu kǎ.
body.en: I have no cash and no card.

body.speaker: 阿姨
body.py: xiǎo gūniang, nǐ yào qù nǎlǐ?
body.en: Young lady, where are you going?

body.speaker: 小舟
body.zh: 我去河西，可是我不知道路。
body.py: wǒ qù Hé Xī, kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào lù.
body.en: I am going to Hexi, but I do not know the way.

body.speaker: 阿姨
body.zh: 河西很大。你说一个门牌号码。
body.py: Hé Xī hěn dà. nǐ shuō yí gè mén pái hàomǎ.
body.en: Hexi is big. Tell me a door number.

body.speaker: 小舟
body.zh: 我只记得一个桥的名字。
body.py: wǒ zhǐ jìde yí gè qiáo de míngzi.
body.en: I only remember the name of a bridge.

body.speaker: 阿姨
body.zh: 那好办。跟我走，前面那辆车到。
body.py: nà hǎo bàn. gēn wǒ zǒu, qiánmiàn nà liàng chē dào.
body.en: That is easy. Come with me, the bus ahead goes there.

body.speaker: 阿姨
body.py: xiān shàng chē, huílái zài gěi.
body.en: Get on the bus first and pay me back later.

body.speaker: 小舟
body.py: xièxie nín, wǒ zěnme huán nín?
body.en: Thank you. How do I pay you back?

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: chē shàng āyí bǎ shuǐ gěi le tā.
body.en: On the bus the aunt gives her some water.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Xiǎo Zhōu yìzhí kàn zhe chuāngwài.
body.en: Xiao Zhou keeps watching out of the window.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 下车时，表姐就在站牌下面。
body.py: xià chē shí, biǎojiě jiù zài zhànpái xiàmiàn.
body.en: When she gets off, her cousin is right under the stop sign.

body.speaker: 小舟
body.py: xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yí lù.
body.en: Thank you for helping me the whole way.

body.speaker: 阿姨
body.zh: 下次出门，带上电，也带上脑子。
body.py: xià cì chūmén, dài shàng diàn, yě dài shàng nǎozi.
body.en: Next time bring a charge, and bring your head too.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 没电 méi diàn — out of battery
背 bèi — to recite from memory
出站 chū zhàn — to leave a station
门牌号码 mén pái hàomǎ — door number
站牌 zhànpái — bus stop sign
一路 yí lù — all the way
带上 dài shàng — to bring along
窗外 chuāngwài — out of the window

blocks.body: Think about it: What three things does the aunt ask for, and which one finally helps? Retell it in three short Chinese sentences.
